result.summary: Found 2 major issues: an untranslated text key displayed as content and a layout problem with truncated restaurant cards.

issues.description: The section title shows 'home_feed.popular_title' which appears to be a raw translation key instead of actual translated text
issues.suggestion: Replace the translation key with the properly translated section title (e.g., 'Popular' or 'Popular Near You')

issues.description: The third restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' section (Trattoria Piccol) is horizontally truncated and not fully visible
issues.suggestion: Adjust the carousel/horizontal scroll layout to ensure all cards are fully visible or properly scrollable without being cut off
